$comment: What doberman knows about this template: how to recognize it, its gates, its risk areas. scripts/doberman.mjs reads it; keep it in step with package.json, .github/workflows/quality-gates.yml and docs/testing.md.

typecheck.name: Typecheck (contract drift, typed routes, astro check, the tooling scripts)

test:coverage.name: Tests + coverage thresholds (app: unit, component, integration, accessibility; API: unit, OpenAPI drift spec; landing: unit)

security.name: Security (audit, dependency and license policy, secrets in the tree)

build.name: Build (the API, the landing, and the app's export: Hermes bytecode for Android and iOS)

perf:check.name: Budgets (the landing: 0 kB of JavaScript, its pages against the web server's CSP; the app: apps/mobile/bundle-budget.json)

extraGates.name: Infrastructure as code (Terraform fmt, validate and tests, TFLint, Trivy, cloud-init schema, the database roles scripts of Terraform and of the server)
extraGates.note: Downloads the Terraform providers and cloud-init from the Ubuntu archive at each run. Creates nothing in any cloud and needs no token: a real plan or apply is never part of a review.

extraGates.name: Repository script tests (Doberman engine, dependency policy, tool images, Semgrep file selection, mock API against the contract, the web image's scripts, the deployment scripts and the server's files, the observability files)
Observability as code (dashboards, alert rules, promtool)
extraGates.note: Static checks of observability/ (datasource references, runbook sections, metric names against observability/api-metrics.json), then promtool from the pinned image: configuration, rules, every dashboard query parsed, the rules unit tests. The static part also runs in pnpm test:scripts.

extraGates.name: Secrets in the git history (gitleaks)
extraGates.commandWindows: MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1 docker run --rm -v "$(cygpath -w "$PWD"):/repo:ro" "$(node scripts/tool-image.mjs gitleaks)" git /repo --redact --no-banner

extraGates.name: Integration tests (API + PostgreSQL + Redis + Mailpit)
extraGates.note: Runs on <db>_test, never the development database; its global setup first replays every migration on an empty <db>_shadow and compares it with schema.prisma (a failure there is a migration that does not run from nothing, or a schema change without its migration). The Redis adapter specs and the outbox specs run against the development Redis and Mailpit (REDIS_URL and MAIL_SMTP_URL of apps/api/.env, or REDIS_TEST_URL and MAIL_TEST_SMTP_URL), each under its own key prefix or mailbox; required in CI, skipped locally without a URL: say so.

extraGates.name: Browser end-to-end tests (Playwright: the built landing and the web image)
extraGates.note: Playwright starts the landing's preview server and builds and runs the web image itself (scripts/e2e-web-image.mjs: minutes the first time, Docker's cache after). Installing the browser is the developer's decision: without it, SKIPPED — REQUIRES CONFIGURATION (`pnpm exec playwright install chromium`).

extraGates.name: Container images (build + Trivy scan)
extraGates.command: per .github/workflows/docker-images.yml: docker build of apps/api/Dockerfile (targets runtime and migrate) and apps/landing/Dockerfile (target runtime: the landing, the app links and their files, the /api proxy), tagged doberman-scan/<image>, then the Trivy scan of each with `node scripts/tool-image.mjs trivy` and the workflow's flags; remove the doberman-scan images afterwards

extraGates.name: Native projects (expo prebuild, Android + iOS)
extraGates.command: pnpm --filter mobile exec expo prebuild --no-install --platform all
extraGates.note: Writes apps/mobile/android/ and apps/mobile/ios/: run it in the sandbox, never in the workspace (`pnpm prebuild` is `--clean`).

extraGates.name: Android release build + Maestro flows
extraGates.command: docs/testing.md#end-to-end: release APK of the e2e variant, then the mock suite (`pnpm mock:api`, `pnpm test:e2e:mobile`) and the stack suite (`pnpm dev`, `pnpm test:e2e:mobile:stack`: the real API, PostgreSQL, Redis and Mailpit)
extraGates.note: The paths are the ones that start .github/workflows/e2e-android.yml. The stack suite needs the development services (the plan's `services`) and the API (`pnpm dev`, on :3010), with the emulator's localhost:4010 forwarded to it (`adb reverse tcp:4010 tcp:3010`, back to tcp:4010 for the mock suite); locally Mailpit may be on another port (`-e MAILPIT_URL=...`, docs/testing.md#end-to-end). On Windows the native build needs a short path (DOBERMAN_TMP=C:\dbm) and a hoisted node_modules (docs/testing.md#end-to-end).

extraGates.name: iOS build + simulator flows
extraGates.command: macOS only: `pnpm ios` (development build) or the release build of docs/testing.md, then `pnpm test:e2e:mobile` on the simulator

database.stop: docker compose stop db redis mailpit
database.note: The template's development services (docker-compose.yml): PostgreSQL, where the suites use <db>_test and <db>_shadow, and the Redis and Mailpit the integration specs and the stack suite reach through apps/api/.env.

areas.focus: mobile sessions with tokens in the body: refresh rotation with family revocation, the 30 s reuse window and superseded successors, the user row lock, sign-in timing, password hashing, token claims and securityVersion; account flows (sign-up, password recovery and change, change of email, invitations, deletion) under the same lock, answering the same whether an address is registered; the user:create command reads the password from standard input
@Auth(...) on every non-public route, roles, ownership in the query (another user's id → 404), no IDOR
Zod DTOs with bounds and named fields in errors[], explicit select, pagination limits, error paths, transactions and locks, idempotency keys, account deletion cascades

committed migration, never an edited one, expand/contract safety while the previous version runs, indexes for new queries, no unbounded queries, no $queryRawUnsafe; migrate-deploy (the api-migrate image) refuses an edited migration
process.env read only in env.ts, schema + .env.example + docs together, optional integrations off by default and never stopping the boot

CacheService/LockService/IdempotencyService only, degradation when Redis is absent, readiness probe, the outbox, external calls through createExternalHttpClient (timeouts, SSRF), the minimum app version gate

the outbox row written in the transaction of the change it reports, notifyQueued() after the commit; claims with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED and every later transition fenced by the claim; no HTTP retry of a send (at least once, never twice by the client); DeviceNotRegistered disables the device; ids only in the payload, no personal data in the text, tokens never logged; a device answers 404 to another account; the app registers at start and sign-in once allowed, never asks for the permission there, removes the installation before the session ends, and opens data.url only through links.ts

rate limits per account or signed-in user behind carrier NAT, with IP ceilings; Fetch Metadata guard, CORS, security and cache headers; the web image's nginx: CSP with script-src 'none', security headers, the /api proxy (client address, private probes); the images: pinned bases, non-root, no package managers
one renewal at a time, generation guard against late renewals, refresh token rotation, restore offline, sign-out cleanup

timeout and abort forwarding, one replay after 401, AppError mapping, breadcrumbs without query strings or bodies; the platform and version headers on every request, a 426 recorded once and the update-required screen left as the only one (never retried, never reported as a bug)

regenerated by pnpm contract, backwards compatibility with installed app versions (additive changes, the minimum version for anything else), status codes, envelope and errors[], named schemas, mock API and fixtures in step
query keys, cancellation (signal), invalidation, optimistic updates and rollback, no retried mutations, nothing copied to Zustand

loading/empty/error/offline states, double submit, unmount during requests, thin routes, Stack.Protected guards, AlertText, a11y spec; account and admin screens offered only once the capabilities say so, roles in the UI a convenience (the API decides), emailed-link screens taking their token once from linkTokens

untrusted input: allowlist, parameter validation, no action performed by a link; emailed tokens only in the fragment and in linkTokens (memory, once, 30 min), never in the path, navigation state, analytics or breadcrumbs

the app's links live under /app/ in three places that change together (the API's APP_BASE_PATH, apps/mobile/src/lib/links.ts with its Android appLink paths, the web image's nginx and link files): the tests that check they agree still do; the open-in-app page at the link's own address, no redirect; the link files JSON, no redirect, 404 without the app's identity
secure vs persistent storage, data inventory, cleared at sign-out, stored data from the previous version still loads
EXPO_PUBLIC_* is public, permissions and usage texts, OTA vs store build, runtimeVersion, store compliance
justified, SDK-compatible (expo install), supply-chain settings never weakened, no new install scripts

redaction: no tokens, passwords or personal data in logs, breadcrumbs, reports or events; API: redaction, ids not personal data, errorTracker once, low-cardinality metric attributes, observability/api-metrics.json in step with the code
roles and accessible names, 48 dp targets, theme tokens only, announcements

every text in both dictionaries (src/i18n), a page per language; static HTML and CSS only (no client script, no inline style, nothing from another origin: the CSP refuses them; 0 kB JavaScript budget); Tailwind classes from src/styles/global.css only; one h1, headings, landmarks, lang attributes, labelled pictures of the app; links into the app through src/lib/links.ts; canonical, hreflang, sitemap and robots.txt from the build site; the privacy and account deletion pages the stores point to

non-root images, pinned digests, migrations before the new version, no secrets in images or compose files, docs/deploy-vps.md and both step-by-step guides updated; the server's data tier (deploy/vps: db, backup, redis) on the internal network only and never published, its roles (db-init.sh) and the Redis ACL no wider than docs/security.md, deploy.sh starting it before the migration, its backups restorable as docs/disaster-recovery.md says; Terraform (infra/terraform) reproduces docs/deploy-vps.md: no secret with a default or in a non-sensitive output, firewalls as narrow as the guide, the lock file and the pinned versions updated together

no gate, threshold, rule or permission weakened; workflows least privilege, pinned, no PR path to releases; Doberman's own knowledge (.claude/skills/doberman) in step with the gates; agent settings never granting what AGENTS.md forbids (releases, pushes to main)
would the tests fail if the code were wrong: realistic stubs, failure paths, races, no snapshots
English and Spanish manuals and step-by-step guides changed together; commands and anchors still exist

reproduction.fileSuffix: .doberman.spec.tsx (or .doberman.spec.ts) for the app; .doberman.spec.ts for API units and the landing, .doberman.int.spec.ts for API integration
reproduction.location: next to the code under test: inside apps/mobile/src/ (jest only collects apps/mobile/src/**/*.spec.ts(x)), apps/api/src/ or apps/landing/src/ (not src/pages, where a file becomes a page): each runner only collects its app's src/
reproduction.runOne: app: pnpm --filter mobile exec jest --coverage=false --runTestsByPath <path from apps/mobile> · API unit: pnpm --filter api exec vitest run <path from apps/api> · API integration (database): pnpm --filter api exec vitest run --config vitest.config.int.ts <path from apps/api> · landing: pnpm --filter landing exec vitest run --coverage=false <path from apps/landing>
